record.hypothesis: Add a fixed training-frequency input feature: count item occurrences only in each category's training split and scale input item embeddings by 0.75 + 0.5*log1p(count)/log1p(max_count), keeping padding zero. Persist these constants as checkpoint buffers. This bounded signal may help gated attention distinguish common anchors from rare items without adding parameters or a separate scorer. Keep candidate embeddings, embedding design, HSTU topology, positions, readout, loss and optimizer unchanged.

category_rationales.rationale: Scale history input embeddings by a fixed, bounded training-frequency feature so gated attention can distinguish common items from rare ones. Counts use only each category's training interactions. Persist the feature as a checkpoint buffer; the generated predictor imports the same model class and restores it automatically. Candidate embeddings, learned parameters, HSTU topology, readout, loss and optimizer remain unchanged.
